executor.name: wowmax-stellar-router
executor.description: On-chain swap-plan executor: atomic split + multi-hop + cross-protocol across Soroswap, Aquarius, Phoenix, plus swap_merge, which executes the route as topologically-ordered stages, splitting each token's pooled balance once across its pools (on-chain fan-in). Output is measured as the contract's own token_out balance delta on every entry point, hop-to-hop token continuity is validated, and amount_out_min is enforced on the summed output. The contract has no admin and no upgrade path. Merge execution tracks per-call token provenance: only the input pulled in this call and the output measured from each fill may be spent, so balances held at the address are invisible to a plan. Every venue invocation must consume exactly the amount it was handed. The merge payout is the token_out balance delta gained during the call, so nothing the call produced is left behind. A zero deadline is translated for venues that compare it against the ledger timestamp.
executor.note: Immutable: no admin function and no upgrade path. Tokens sent to this address outside a swap, or unsolicited tokens side-transferred by a venue in an asset the route did not declare, cannot be recovered by anyone.

superseded.note: Superseded by CCLOEJI4. Its swap_merge derived the payout from internal accounting and checked the physical balance delta only as a lower bound, so token_out delivered outside a fill's declared destination would have been left in the contract permanently.

Superseded by CAZ3F6BP after an external second-opinion review. Its swap_merge treated the contract's absolute token balance as spendable capital; balances were verified zero throughout, so this was never exploited.

Original executor. Superseded by CBLMXS6U…: the current build adds swap_merge and the balance-delta accounting, so a single deployment now covers both roles. Contracts are immutable; replacement is by redeployment.
Pooled-merge executor. Superseded by CBLMXS6U…, which carries the same entry points plus the hardened accounting and validation.
